actual_reference_images.observation: Actual2013 elevated photo: open elongated bowl, stepped uncovered general seating, radial aisle bands and small inward openings, red perimeter exterior, one visible flat-roof covered side stand with paired pale taller flanks and ground-level inward arches. Foreground rounded/short-end gate appears to have a wider rectangular central passage and two smaller side arches. This differs from the2021near photo and does not identify it as the same gate. Temporary golf shed/netting and later lighting are distinct dated-use features, not mandatory1935construction.

Actual2021 close photo: three large arched front openings separated by four pale major piers/towers, rear recessed arches and gated/partly closed rear planes, multi-tier eave/bracket band, narrow vertical windows, top urns on outer towers. Do not replace with opaque painted arches or claim all three corridors are freely open through the whole stadium. Geographic orientation still awaits mapping.

Actual2017inner-field view: local flat canopy and two flanking pale towers with top urns, stepped stand seating, three arched openings at the lower inner wall with dark back/closure planes. Does not prove three unobstructed ground corridors. Event marquees/player shelters are temporary.

Actual red-brick outer numbered gate: deep arched opening, iron gate and visibly ascending stairs behind. A recessed opening rather than a flat decal is supported; a through-road to field at ground level is not supported.
Distant city photo with a partly occluded stadium: open grass field and exposed stands persist; low resolution and surrounding occlusion cannot determine detailed gate design or measured height.

Actual2013close outside front: three large nearly equal arched recesses, substantial four-pier composition, eave/bracket belt, recessed back arches with grilles. This confirms the2021close-image form existed in2013, but does not by itself identify which stadium side.
Actually viewed historical1934 site design illustration: open elongated stadium, separate indoor gym and swimming buildings. Not a modern aerial or accurate current source footprint.

Actually viewed originalPDF20/printed12: caption第四圖 上海市運動場一層平面圖, open central track/field, perimeter stand rooms and distinct projecting blocks at the two long-side middles. Used only for design-scope topology, not pixel-scaled current dimensions.

Actually viewed originalPDF21/printed13: caption reads第五圖 上海市運動場西門立面圖. Outside elevation shows three large arches, four major piers and outer urn towers; inside elevation shows two flanking tower masses and special-stand/inner three-arch base. This supports linking2021outside gate and2017inside covered stand as two different faces of the west gate group. It is a1934design drawing, not modern measurement.

Actual originalPDF22/printed14caption第六圖 上海市運動場剖面圖: separate west-gate/stand sections, sloping/stepped seating over interior voids and wall/roof level differences. Qualitative construction only; blurry dimensional numerals not decoded into present-day measurements.
